messages:
mia: Heads-up — I opened a docs PR to clarify rate limit/quota UX and hand off updated SDK snippets. Need quick reviews from eng and analytics before merge.

raj: Can you paste the snippet we want in the SDK section? I'll validate headers and example responses.

mia: Sure—added a minimal snippet for quota headers and retry-backoff. See below and the PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1127 :eyes:

```http
GET /v1/complete
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer $KEY
X-RateLimit-Limit: 100
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 12
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1640995200
```

raj: Quick note — X-RateLimit-Reset is epoch seconds, but our SDK exposes reset_in_seconds in the response metadata. Add line explaining mapping (reset_in_seconds = X-RateLimit-Reset - now()).

mia: Good point — I added a parenthetical note and an example mapping snippet under "Interpreting headers".

alex: Also fixed the dashboard link that was pointing to old ops pages. New link: https://console.redwood.ai/usage -> update redirects in the docs.

sam: I can run the snippet in a sandbox. @raj want me to include a test case to validate header parsing? :wave:

raj: Yes please. Add an automated unit test in clients/python/test_rate_limit.py that asserts remaining decreases after calls and reset is parsed as seconds. Keep it lightweight.

lina: Localization note — the copy 'usage tier' -> 'billing tier' is inconsistent in some languages. Please change the UI string key to dashboard.billing_tier to avoid mismatch across translations.

docs-bot: PR #1127 opened by @mia for 'Clarify rate limits & quota UX + SDK snippet handoff'. CI: pending, checklist: [ ] unit tests [ ] analytics event docs [ ] link redirects

sam: I'll add the unit tests and analytics event docs. ETA EOD.

mia: Thanks. One more for the release notes: add a short 'Docs: Clarify rate limit headers and SDK snippet' line under 2026-04-01 patch.

raj: LGTM once tests and mapping note are in. :thumbsup:

alex: I'll update the console redirect and ping infra for the link.

lina: I'll queue localization change with l10n team — marking as blocking for translations though not for English docs.

mia: Great. If anything blocks merge, post here. Otherwise I'll merge after CI and unit tests.

docs-bot: CI passed for PR #1127. Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference/docs/pr-1127. Merge when ready. :shipit:

sam: tests green locally, pushed test file, added analytics event doc snippet.

mia: Merged. Thanks everyone :tada:
